robots.text: Kalki, please greet our guests with a bow.
robots.en: Kalki, please greet our guests with a bow.

robots.text: Skip, spin and lift your legs.
robots.en: Skip, spin and lift your legs.

robots.text: March with high knees and swing your arms.
robots.en: March with high knees and swing your arms.

robots.text: Spin around with big arm circles.
robots.en: Spin around with big arm circles.

robots.text: Raise and swing your arms, one after the other.
robots.en: Raise and swing your arms, one after the other.

robots.text: Spin, wave your arms and step around.
robots.en: Spin, wave your arms and step around.

robots.text: Jog on the spot to warm up.
robots.en: Jog on the spot to warm up.

robots.text: Stretch your arms and loosen your neck.
robots.en: Stretch your arms and loosen your neck.

robots.text: Jump, knees up, and wave your arms!
robots.en: Jump, knees up, and wave your arms!

robots.text: Walk like a zombie, just for fun.
robots.en: Walk like a zombie, just for fun.

robots.text: कल्कि, भांगड़ा जैसे ज़ोरदार ठुमके लगाओ।
robots.en: Kalki, do some energetic bhangra-style moves.

robots.text: खुशी में कूदो और हाथ लहराओ।
robots.en: Jump for joy and wave your hands.

robots.text: घुटने ऊपर उठाओ, ताली बजाओ और घूमो।
robots.en: Lift your knees, clap and turn.

robots.text: उछलकर ताली बजाओ और कमर घुमाओ।
robots.en: Hop, clap and twist your waist.
Hop on the spot and spin.
March in place like a parade.

robots.text: एक पैर पर संतुलन बनाओ, वृक्षासन की तरह।
robots.en: Balance on one leg, like the tree pose.

robots.text: बाजू फैलाकर बगल में और आगे झुको।
robots.en: Arms out, bend to the side and forward.

robots.text: हाथ सिर के ऊपर ले जाकर शरीर घुमाओ।
robots.en: Raise your arms overhead and rotate.

robots.text: घूमते हुए उछलो और बाजू झुलाओ।
robots.en: Skip and turn, swinging your arms.

robots.text: कदमताल करते हुए धड़ घुमाओ और बाजू झुलाओ।
robots.en: March in place, twist your torso and swing your arms.

robots.text: बगल में कदम रखो, कमर मटकाओ और बाजू झुलाओ।
robots.en: Step side to side, sway your hips and swing your arms.

robots.text: बैठकर पैर फेंकने वाला नाच करो।
কল্কি, ভেসে চলার মতো হাত দোলাও।
robots.en: Kalki, glide and sweep your arms.

robots.text: দু'পাশে পা ফেলে হাত দিয়ে বৃত্ত আঁকো।
robots.en: Step side to side, drawing arcs with your arms.
Dance in a soft, flowing rhythm.
Sway your body and wave your arms.

robots.text: ধুনুচি নাচের মতো ঘুরে ঘুরে নাচো।
robots.en: Spin and dance, like the dhunuchi dance.

robots.text: হাত মাথার ওপর রেখে তালে তালে পা ফেলো।
robots.en: Arms overhead, step to the beat.
Arms out, keep your balance and turn.

robots.text: কানে হাত রেখে বাউলের মতো দোলো।
robots.en: Hand to your ear, sway like a Baul singer.

robots.text: কানে হাত দিয়ে নেচে নেচে ঘোরো।
robots.en: Hand to your ear, dance and turn.

robots.text: হাত পিছনে রেখে দুলে দুলে নাচো।
robots.en: Hands behind your back, sway and dance.
Hands on hips, sway and spin.
Dance back and forth with a few kicks.

robots.text: পা ফেলে গোল করে কিক মারো।
robots.en: Step and kick in a circle.

robots.text: শরীর ঘুরিয়ে, হাত ছড়িয়ে ভারসাম্য রাখো।
robots.en: Twist your body and spread your arms for balance.

robots.text: கல்கி, சிலம்பம் போல கை வீச்சுகள் காட்டு.

robots.en: Kick in many ways and keep your balance.
Lean over and kick your legs.

robots.text: பல திசைகளில் அடி வைத்து கைகளை அசை.
robots.en: Step in all directions and wave your arms.
Kalki, march to the beat and turn.
Turn and step with swinging arms.
Lift your legs, wave your arms and spin.
Sweep your arms and lift your legs.
Hop in place and spin around.

robots.text: అడ్డ అడుగులతో కవాతు చేస్తూ చేతులు ఊపు.
robots.en: March with cross steps, swinging your arms sideways.
Hold your arms out at shoulder height.
Stand with your arms curved forward.
Lift your right foot and swing it sideways.

robots.text: అడుగులు వేస్తూ, తిరుగుతూ, చేతులు ఊపుతూ నాట్యం చెయ్యి.
robots.en: Step, spin and swing your arms in a dance.
